//: The getting-started course, as `public/lessons.js` in prospektor-ai/studio holds it, read out of that checkout by `npm run lessons:snapshot`. Do not hand-edit: `/learn/` draws these pages from it (#742) and `tools/resources-coverage.js` checks their names against the product.

groups.name: Your first meeting from a cold company
Get walked in by someone you know
Make every pitch sharper than the last

lessons.subject: Glance one company
lessons.opener: Leads for you holds companies worth approaching, each with a fit score out of 100 and one line on why.
bullets: Glance reads one company in about fifteen seconds.
Skip teaches the studio what not to bring back.
The shelf is built from Ideal customer, under Settings.
lessons.close: Glance the one you would most like a meeting with.
lessons.label: Open Leads for you

lessons.subject: Prospekt the one you glanced
lessons.opener: One press on Prospekt writes the pitch: why them, who decides, and the first email, in your voice.
bullets: It runs in the background. Leave the screen and it finishes without you.
Every claim carries the page it came from.
The finished pitch lands in the Library.
lessons.close: Read it to the end. Next you make the email yours.
lessons.label: Open Leads for you

lessons.subject: Make the email yours
lessons.opener: A saved edit is a lesson. Fix the one sentence you would never send, and every later pitch is written with that in mind.
bullets: Open the pitch in the Library and press Edit on the email.
Change the line that is not you. Leave the rest.
Save. The studio keeps the before and the after as a voice record.
lessons.close: Then send it from your own mailbox.
lessons.label: Open the Library

lessons.subject: Bring in who you know
lessons.opener: Your network turns a cold pitch into a warm one. Import it once and every pitch after it checks who already knows the way in.
bullets: Export your LinkedIn connections as Connections.csv and drop it on Your network.
Or paste a list of names and companies. Either works.
Email addresses are dropped at import. Only you can remove what you imported.
lessons.label: Open Your network

lessons.subject: Find the person who can walk you in
lessons.opener: Warm intros takes a company and finds who you know that knows the people who decide there.
bullets: Type the company. It opens with who you already know there.
Each path comes with an intro request, written in your voice.
Every finished pitch carries the same Warm paths panel.
lessons.close: Send the request to the person on the best path.
lessons.label: Open Warm intros

lessons.subject: Find a competitor’s clients
lessons.opener: Counterprospekt reads who buys from a competitor, and names a client only when a page it read says so.
bullets: Press Find their clients on a competitor, or add one by name.
Each client links the page that names it.
They all land in one table, Leads from your competitors.
lessons.close: A competitor’s client already pays for what you sell.
lessons.label: Open Counterprospekt

lessons.subject: Write to one of them
lessons.opener: The best fit in that table is your next pitch.
bullets: Press Glance on the client you would most like to win.
Then press Write the pitch.
Open the pitch once it lands, and send the email.
lessons.close: One switch from a competitor is worth ten cold replies.
lessons.label: Open Counterprospekt

lessons.subject: Say what happened
lessons.opener: A recorded outcome is what every later pitch, prep sheet and evaluation is written from.
bullets: Press the badge on any lead: replied, meeting, won, lost, or never answered.
Add one line in your own words. That line is worth more than the badge.
Make sense of this reads the record back: what won, what lost, what to ask next.
lessons.close: A workspace that records nothing writes run 100 like run 1.
lessons.label: Open Outcomes

lessons.subject: Teach it from your calls
lessons.opener: A notetaker already wrote your calls down. Those transcripts teach the brief the way a won or lost deal does.
bullets: Export them from Fathom, Otter, Granola or Zoom.
Press Bring your call recordings on Outcomes and pick up to six.
Each objection, question and answer that landed waits for your Keep.
lessons.close: Every pitch after that answers the objection before it is raised.
lessons.label: Open Outcomes
